function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH aug AS (
  SELECT channel, margin_per_unit_cad
  FROM (
    SELECT s.period, c.channel,
           (SUM(s.revenue_cad) - SUM(s.cost_cad)) / NULLIF(SUM(s.qty),0) AS margin_per_unit_cad
    FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line s
    JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl ON s.sku = pl.sku AND s.period = pl.period
    WHERE s.period = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY s.period, c.channel
  ) sub
),
sep AS (
  SELECT channel, SUM(s.qty) AS qty, SUM(s.revenue_cad) - SUM(s.cost_cad) AS margin_cad
  FROM (
    SELECT s.qty, s.revenue_cad,
           s.qty * (pl.amount_cad / pl.qty) AS cost_cad
    FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line s
    JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl ON s.sku = pl.sku AND s.period = pl.period
    WHERE s.period = '2026-09'
  ) sub
  GROUP BY channel
),
sep_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(margin_cad) AS total_margin_cad
  FROM sep
),
aug_margins AS (
  SELECT channel, margin_per_unit_cad FROM aug
),
sep_qty AS (
  SELECT channel, qty FROM sep
)
SELECT 
  SUM(sep_qty.qty * aug_margins.margin_per_unit_cad) AS hypothetical_margin_cad,
  sep_total.total_margin_cad AS actual_sep_margin_cad,
  (SUM(sep_qty.qty * aug_margins.margin_per_unit_cad) - sep_total.total_margin_cad) AS mix_effect_cad
FROM sep_qty
JOIN aug_margins ON sep_qty.channel = aug_margins.channel
CROSS JOIN sep_total","purpose":"Compute mix effect: hypothetical margin if Sep quantities sold at Aug unit margins minus actual Sep margin"}
